responsibility: Provides the public x86 ADX integer intrinsics layer for multi-precision add-with-carry and subtract-with-borrow operations. This header belongs to GCC’s i386 builtin interface rather than code generation itself: it exposes inline wrappers such as _addcarry_u32/_u64, _addcarryx_u32/_u64, and _subborrow_u32/_u64 that map directly onto GCC x86 builtins, with 64-bit forms gated on __x86_64__, so front-end code can request ADX semantics and GCC can lower them to the corresponding target instructions.
